What we check

The four areas most often behind complaints and fines.

We review what your visitors actually see and what your website actually loads.

  • 01

    GDPR basics

    How personal data is collected and presented — forms, notices and the visible privacy setup.

  • 02

    Cookie consent

    Whether consent is clear, whether rejecting is as easy as accepting and whether tracking waits for a choice.

  • 03

    Privacy & legal pages

    Your privacy policy, legal notice (Impressum) and the forms that link to them.

  • 04

    Third-party tracking

    Analytics, ad pixels, embedded videos, maps, fonts and other external resources.

Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Is the check really free?
Yes. The check costs nothing. If we find no issues, you pay nothing at all.
What does the fix from €99 include?
We set up consent correctly, block trackers until consent where your platform allows it, complete your privacy policy and legal notice from the information you provide, add form notices and links to legal pages, and re-check the website afterwards.
Do you change my website without asking?
No. We only make changes after you accept the offer, and only the ones described in it.
What do you need from me?
Access to your website (for example a temporary admin login) or your developer's contact — plus the business details that belong in your privacy policy and legal notice.
Is this legal advice?
No. The check and the fix are practical, technical work based on EU and national rules. They are not legal advice and do not guarantee compliance. For legal advice, consult a qualified lawyer.
Which countries do you cover?
Websites aimed at customers in the EU and the UK, with particular experience in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Spain and Croatia.
How do I pay?
You receive an offer with the price before any work starts. You pay only after you have accepted it.
